use_case: Demand forecasting and automated reordering: weekly SKU demand forecasts and suggested purchase orders with a suggested supplier
business_owner: Sales Operations Manager (with the Purchasing and Supplier Manager for supplier selection)
vendor_or_model: Forecasting add-on vendor (machine learning time-series models trained per customer on ERP data)
build_or_buy: Buy (SaaS add-on connected to the ERP, SYS-12)
data_categories: ERP order history for 3 years including DoD orders (FCI); reseller account identifiers; inventory; supplier lead times and prices; supplier list including brokers
affects_individuals: No (indirectly affects service levels for reseller businesses)
human_in_the_loop: A buyer reviews and approves every suggested purchase order; auto-release is disabled and may not be enabled without re-assessment
applicable_laws: FAR 52.204-21 and CMMC Level 1 (FCI in the vendor feed); FAR 52.204-25 and DFARS 252.246-7008 (supplier suggestions); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: Approved with conditions (pilot since 2026-03; DoD orders to be removed from the feed by 2026-10-31)

use_case: General-purpose generative AI used by staff to draft emails, product descriptions, and spec sheet summaries
vendor_or_model: One approved enterprise generative AI assistant (commercial terms with no training on company data; SSO); public consumer chatbots not approved
data_categories: Internal and Confidential data only; CUI and FCI prohibited
risk_tier: Low (approved tool with data rules); High if CUI or FCI were entered
human_in_the_loop: Staff check every output before use; product claims to customers must be verified against the OEM spec sheet
applicable_laws: DFARS 252.204-7012 and SP 800-171 (no CUI in AI tools); FAR 52.204-21 (no FCI); FTC Act Section 5 (accurate product claims)
status: Approved with conditions (enterprise tool from 2026-10-01; public chatbots blocked on lab workstations)
